description_zh: 调用GetEventCallback获取事件回调配置
name: GetEventCallback

AuthKey.description_en: The authentication key. This parameter is returned only for HTTP callbacks

AuthSwitch.description_en:
Specifies whether callback authentication is enabled. This parameter is returned only for HTTP callbacks. Valid values:

on

off
AuthSwitch.description_zh:
HTTP回调的鉴权开关，回调方式设置为HTTP时，此参数有效。取值：
on（启用）
off（不启用）

CallbackQueueName.description_en: The name of the Simple Message Queue (SMQ) queue to which callback messages are sent

CallbackType.description_en:
The callback method. Valid values:

HTTP

MNS
CallbackType.description_zh:
回调方式，取值：
HTTP
MNS

回调方式说明，详情请参见[回调方式说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610204.html）

CallbackURL.description_en: The callback URL to which event notifications are sent

EventTypeList.description_en: The type of the callback event. Multiple values are separated with commas (,). For more information about callback event types, see [Event notification content]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610204.html）
EventTypeList.description_zh: 回调事件类型，多值以逗号分隔。事件类型参考 [事件通知内容]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610174.html）
